purpose: Provide stable machine-readable identities, evidence links, snapshot maturity and activation semantics for the seven peer Human-AI collaboration gaps without becoming a mutable planning registry or current-state clock.

authority.numbering_rule: OC number is stable identity only; it is not rank, phase, priority or sequence.
authority.future_activation_rule: Create a focused current work/preflight item only when a current activation trigger is established; reread fresh repository state and original evidence first.

evidence_maturity_rule: Levels describe positive capability evidence, not severity or priority. Negative real-use evidence must not be converted into a higher positive maturity level.

invalid_activation_reasons: candidate has a low maturity level
potentially_valid_activation_reasons: current real workflow encounters the gap
current admitted slice depends on the capability
existing promised requirement cannot be credibly met without it
negative real-use evidence makes continued deferral materially costly
new SOTA regulatory or safety evidence changes the material risk

candidates.name: Human Role / Minimal Input / Intent Reconstruction
candidates.need: The Human can communicate tersely, colloquially, symptom-first and with imperfect terminology without becoming the system's prompt engineer, domain analyst or repository orchestrator.
component_evidence: Material-state and Harvest contracts can preserve source role/authority candidates.
No end-to-end terse free-text intent reconstruction runtime is demonstrated.
negative_real_use_evidence: Current Human-AI collaboration chat required repeated reframing/correction.
FF-EXECUTION-PROGRESS explicitly records terse free-text intent reconstruction as an open gap.
uncertainties: Exact boundary between safe reconstruction and Human clarification remains judgement-heavy.
Whether current Governing Objective owner wording is compatible with the clarified input model remains unresolved.
open_architecture_questions: Whether intent reconstruction needs any persistent object beyond existing Material State / Context / Integration mechanisms.
activation_triggers: A current admitted work item again requires the Human to provide derivable problem/context structure.
Terse Human input is materially misread after repository context reconstruction.
An admitted slice explicitly depends on intent reconstruction.
Human Owner explicitly prioritizes the capability.
candidates.authority_boundary: Human meaning/value/priority remains Human authority; reconstruction must not silently promote inferred meaning.

candidates.name: Context & Work Instruction Compilation
candidates.need: The Human need not courier derivable context or construct expert execution prompts; the system should compile bounded work context/instructions from current state and intent.
component_evidence: tools/work.py context() is executable but currently coarse/near-full.
Pilot context/token fixtures are regression-protected for simpler reference-set behavior.
P2 bounded-context semantics are independently preflight-confirmed but not implemented.
negative_real_use_evidence: High-quality work repeatedly depended on Human-supplied long meta-prompts.
Current context() does not accept/bind a Human work intent as a full Work Instruction compiler.
uncertainties: A persistent Work Packet object may be unnecessary; object/storage form remains open.
open_architecture_questions: How much Work Instruction compilation belongs in BB-CONTEXT versus composition across existing owners.
dependencies_enablers: P2 bounded context/provenance is a direct subset/enabler, not the whole OC-02 capability.
activation_triggers: After P2, material Human-authored meta-prompting remains necessary.
A later admitted workflow needs derivable work instructions or stop conditions.
Repeated work shows the same context/instruction compilation burden.
non_activation_conditions: A single task can be handled adequately without persistent new machinery.
candidates.authority_boundary: P2 scope remains bounded; broader Work Instruction compilation requires separate activation and current-state validation.

candidates.name: Competence / Research / Uncertainty Routing
candidates.need: The system identifies and obtains missing domain, method and technical competence and researches current evidence when warranted instead of using the Human as substitute specialist.
component_evidence: Competence taxonomy and SOTA/fit semantics exist.
Task-triggered end-to-end competence/research routing is not demonstrated in the current operational core.
negative_real_use_evidence: Human explicitly states they cannot and will not supply missing domain/technology expertise.
uncertainties: Which task classes require automated research versus judgement-based routing.
open_architecture_questions: Whether existing BB-COMPETENCE/BB-RESEARCH composition is sufficient without new orchestration structure.
activation_triggers: Material work depends on competence absent from current task context.
A current workflow cannot establish fit without SOTA/standards evidence.
Human is again asked to supply specialist knowledge the system can acquire.
non_activation_conditions: Research is merely interesting but not material to current work.
candidates.authority_boundary: Research can inform options and fit; Human/specialist authority remains separate where meaning, risk or critical expertise requires it.

candidates.name: Partial Automation / Function Allocation / Orchestration
candidates.need: Real workflows are decomposed into appropriate deterministic, routine-automation, AI-judgement, specialist-judgement and Human-authority functions instead of being manually orchestrated through meta-prompts.
component_evidence: Execution guard and CI assurance provide executable automation for bounded functions.
No generic end-to-end function-allocation/orchestration capability is demonstrated.
negative_real_use_evidence: PR #35 review/correction/re-review required substantial derivable orchestration through Human/assistant-authored prompts.
uncertainties: How generic a reusable orchestration protocol should be.
Whether repeated workflows justify any new orchestration abstraction beyond existing owners.
open_architecture_questions: Protocol/workflow composition versus new dedicated orchestration mechanism remains open.
activation_triggers: A material workflow repeatedly requires manual coordination of deterministic, judgement and Human-gate steps.
Another real workflow confirms generic-fit of the same burden.
Human Owner explicitly prioritizes automation of an already evidenced workflow.
An admitted capability requires coordinated multi-step execution.
non_activation_conditions: PR #35 exists as an example but no current work requires orchestration changes.
A new workflow can be completed adequately without persistent orchestration machinery.
candidates.authority_boundary: Automation may coordinate work but must not create priority, material acceptance or implementation authority.

candidates.name: Human Decision Context / Review Experience / XAI
candidates.need: At material Human gates, the system automatically provides orientation, evidence, uncertainty, alternatives, consequences, reversibility, exact decision scope and drill-down trace without making the Human integrate repository state manually.
component_evidence: Decision Brief contract is referenced by Authority/Building Blocks and structurally validated.
Automatic end-to-end generation/delivery at a real material gate is not demonstrated.
negative_real_use_evidence: Human repeatedly requested more context, orientation and transparency.
CURRENT_STATE does not surface the current P2 admission gate as a complete decision-ready packet.
uncertainties: Exact Human-facing presentation/UI and progressive-disclosure implementation remain open.
open_architecture_questions: Whether decision context is generated on demand from existing state or requires a dedicated derived artifact.
activation_triggers: A material Human gate again requires manual state reconstruction.
P2/result review or later work needs an automatic decision packet.
Issue #6 is explicitly activated by current planning.
non_activation_conditions: A routine action requires no material Human decision.
candidates.authority_boundary: Decision support must clarify Human authority, not replace it; readable summaries must preserve drill-down evidence and uncertainty.

candidates.name: Iterative Discovery / Error Culture / Operational Learning
candidates.need: Failures, uncertainty and Human feedback remain visible and are converted into validated future behavior changes or explicit no-change/defer/reject dispositions.
component_evidence: Material-state persistence, audit deltas and failure-regression candidates exist.
Generic closure from observation through operational change to later effectiveness evidence is not demonstrated.
negative_real_use_evidence: Current conversation required repeated correction without an existing automated learning closure.
2026-09-19 design-method audit identifies real iterative discovery/learning gaps.
uncertainties: Which learning classes warrant deterministic regression versus judgement review.
How to measure later Human effectiveness without creating burdensome telemetry.
open_architecture_questions: No new learning store is justified; use of existing failure corpus/material state versus future refinements remains open.
activation_triggers: Repeated feedback is persisted but does not alter future checks/workflow or receive explicit no-change disposition.
A real implementation result generates learning needing operational closure.
The design-method gap becomes necessary for current product/problem work.
non_activation_conditions: A one-off non-material observation has no future consequence.
candidates.authority_boundary: Learning may propose reframe/refinement; material requirement/domain/priority promotion remains controlled.

candidates.name: Cumulative Correction Fidelity / Interaction Continuity
candidates.need: Multiple Human corrections accumulate into one still-valid working model; later corrections do not silently erase earlier valid constraints.
component_evidence: No dedicated demonstrated same-interaction cumulative correction mechanism/regression exists.
negative_real_use_evidence: Current conversation repeatedly incorporated the latest correction while dropping earlier peer concerns.
uncertainties: Whether correction/supersession semantics need explicit structure or can be reliably derived from existing material-state/trace mechanisms.
open_architecture_questions: Exact relation between same-interaction correction chains, Harvest and future Work Packet/context compilation.
activation_triggers: The failure recurs in another representative task.
An admitted Work Packet/Harvest/Context change requires explicit correction-chain semantics.
Current work cannot remain faithful without correction/supersession handling.
Human Owner explicitly prioritizes the capability.
non_activation_conditions: Current negative evidence is acknowledged but no current work depends on a correction mechanism.
candidates.authority_boundary: Correction fidelity preserves Human statements and their relations; it must not infer that every later statement supersedes earlier intent.

unresolved: Interpretation of the Governing Objective phrase fachlich bzw. konzeptionell kompetent relative to the clarified Human input model.
Whether any future axis requires a new Building Block after existing-owner fit is tested with real work.
Whether repeated future activation creates enough burden to justify a mutable machine-readable registry.
Whether a persistent Work Packet object is needed or work instructions can remain derived.
